title: eval publish-report and nightly job result

comparedRunId.description: The run compared with (EvaluationRuns.ComparedRunId); absent for a collection's first run.

questionCount.description: Answerable questions (with expected documents): the denominator of recall@k (EvaluationRuns.QuestionCount).

found.description: Answerable questions with an expected document in the top k.

wins.description: Questions found now and not in the compared run, and the reverse.

recallAlert.description: nightly: recall@10 fell 5 points or more below the 4-week median (processing design §14.8).

recallAtK.description: recall@k over the answerable questions (EvaluationRuns.RecallAtK); absent without answerable questions.

mrr.description: MRR@k over the answerable questions (EvaluationRuns.Mrr); absent without answerable questions.

totalP50Ms.description: Median of the questions' total search time (SearchTimings.TotalMs), milliseconds.

totalP95Ms.description: 95th percentile (nearest rank) of the questions' total search time, milliseconds.

rerankP50Ms.description: Median of the questions' rerank time, text read included (SearchTimings.RerankMs); absent for a run without rerank.

rerankP95Ms.description: 95th percentile (nearest rank) of the questions' rerank time; absent for a run without rerank.

rerankUnavailable.description: Questions whose rerank fell back to the fused order (degraded rerank_unavailable).

rerankModel.description: The rerank model that answered (RerankUsage.Model), or the platform model for the variant's reranker (Settings.Retrieval.rerankModel or gatewayRerankModel) when none answered; absent for a run without rerank.

rerankPromptTokens.description: Prompt tokens of every rerank call of the run.

rerankCompletionTokens.description: Completion tokens of every rerank call of the run.

rerankCostPerQueryUsd.description: Rerank cost per question in USD: the tokens at GatewayModels.InputPerMillionUsd (and OutputPerMillionUsd for completion tokens; a gateway rerank model bills input only), over Searches; absent without rerank or without the prices its tokens need.

search.description: Search latency of the run's questions (#399).

questions.description: Answerable questions (with expected documents): the denominator of recall@k.

found.description: Answerable questions with an expected document in the top k.

unanswerable.description: Questions without expected documents (expected outcome "not found"); not counted in recall@k and MRR@k.

recallAtK.description: Found / Questions; absent without answerable questions.

layers.description: The run per question layer, human (the gold set) first (processing design §13.4, weakness review §2).

description: Result of an eval job of kind publish-report or nightly: the EvaluationRuns row written and its comparison with the previous run; per-question results are in the row's results.
